propositions: Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, the outbound comment differ's dedup key computation uses asymmetric decoders: local side applies markdown round trip (escaping special chars), Jira side uses plain adf_to_text (no escaping), causing matched comments to be re-emitted as duplicates

When a markdown comment with active characters (*, [], <>) and autolinks is landed on Jira, its wire form is degraded to plain text by the send path's HTML decoration fallback, but the local dedup key round-trips the undecorated body through rich markdown encoding, producing mismatched keys

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact wire produced by the send path (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used for the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry
The root cause originated in commit 27b868ba55 which moved the send path onto codec ADF encoding while leaving the Jira-side key on adf_to_text, creating the decode composition divergence

Validation across an 8-cell matrix (cutover setting × comment type) confirms the one-decoder fix produces matching keys in all cells while preserving correct behavior for plaintext and already-matching cases
